scheme_name: Dr. Ambedkar Medhavi Chhatravriti Yojna to Other Backward Classes Students
other_conditions: Scholarship is limited to a maximum of two successive years after matriculation
Renewal for the second year is conditional on satisfactory performance in the first year
The student must take admission to any professional/technical course after matric in a recognized institution within or outside the state
Selection is based strictly on merit among OBC students who appear in the Matric Examination
benefits_summary: Each eligible student receives ₹18,000 per year for up to two years after matriculation.
documents_required: Printed copy of the Online Scholarship Form (after successful online submission)
All requisite supporting documents as per the student's records
